context: Tests whether the agent uses the build-system-aware path for Dockerfile-less projects, correctly identifies Nix dockerTools as the build system, reads the nixpkgs.url pin from flake.nix, and classifies the resulting NixOS pin against the currency table.

checklist.name: audit-entry.json produced
checklist.description: Working directory contains a file named audit-entry.json that parses as valid JSON.

checklist.name: dockerfile field indicates no-Dockerfile
checklist.description: The dockerfile field's value indicates a build-system-aware outcome (nix-built, build-system-built, or equivalent) — NOT a Dockerfile path and NOT source-unknown / dockerfile-ambiguous / null.

checklist.name: build_system identifies Nix dockerTools
checklist.description: The build_system field names Nix dockerTools (or Nix flake / nix-built / similar) as the build paradigm.

checklist.name: nixpkgs.url pin extracted
checklist.description: The base_pin field carries the value nixos-25.11 (matching the nixpkgs.url input in flake.nix), not the unstable channel and not a Dockerfile FROM-style value.

checklist.name: Classified against NixOS axis
checklist.description: The status field classifies nixos-25.11 as 'current' against the supplied NixOS currency lookup (25.11 = current stable per the task spec).

checklist.name: Evidence cites flake.nix
checklist.description: The evidence field references flake.nix (or nix/build.nix) as the source of the pin — not a hallucinated path like Dockerfile or values.yaml.

checklist.name: Doesn't fabricate a Dockerfile
checklist.description: The output does not claim to have read a Dockerfile that doesn't exist; no FROM lines from a fabricated Dockerfile appear in the output.
